# walk.housevideo.app

GitHub Pages target for the Freedom Mortgage Pavilion preshow venue walk.

**Do not edit files here.** Everything except this README and `.github/` is
generated and pushed by `DaveHomeAssist/system-by-dave`
(`scripts/publish_domain_site.sh`) after its release gates pass. Edits are
overwritten on the next publish.

| Where the content comes from | |
| --- | --- |
| Canonical app source | `DaveHomeAssist/fmp-suite` |
| Staging and publishing | `DaveHomeAssist/system-by-dave` |
| Site definition | `scripts/domain-sites.json`, site id `housevideo-walk` |

`source.json` records the exact source commit and artifact digest of whatever is
currently published. The workflow in `.github/workflows/pages.yml` skips the
deploy until that file exists, so this repository is inert until the first
publish lands.

Sibling targets: `DaveHomeAssist/housevideo` (housevideo.app) and
`DaveHomeAssist/avbydave` (avbydave.com).
